## Intended use
Minimal correction to the near-final canonical Falanaras portrait, preserving the armor design while fixing one disproportioned feature.

## Edit source — provider input image 1
falanaras-neutral-frontal-wretched-style-canonical-candidate-1.png (c9aef203-990f-4ea5-a791-0985b89bb7fe). This is the image to edit.

## Desired edited result
Inside the very narrow mask only, shorten the existing central red upper point of the faceguard so its visible height and proportion match the supplied cropped in-game reference. Retain the same point shape, width, red material, center alignment, and connection to the existing faceguard. Remove only the excess top length; naturally restore the source portrait's white hair and dark background where that excess point is removed. Do not rebuild or alter any other part of the helm.

## Continuity priorities
Preserve the original source portrait exactly outside the mask, especially the complete existing faceguard structure below and beside the central point, open face, forehead relationship, eyes, facial anatomy, expression, hair, ears, ponytail, armor, pose, sword, heraldry, setting, lighting, and painterly finish.

## Composition after edit
No composition change whatsoever.

## Purposeful use of space after edit
Unless the brief explicitly calls for a sparse, minimalist, isolated-study, or open-field composition, concentrate quiet negative space only in explicit text-reservation regions. Everywhere else, make each area contribute to subject, setting, atmosphere, depth, scale, motion, focus, or visual flow without adding clutter. Atmospheric open space is purposeful when it clearly establishes mood or scale; avoid large unmotivated blank areas and do not invent a text landing zone where none was requested.

## Lighting and mood after edit
Match the source portrait exactly.

## Reference image roles (actual provider input order)
Provider input image 2: Authoritative proportional reference only for the length of the faceguard's central upper point. Preserve: The relative height of the central red point compared with the existing faceguard below it.. Must change: Do not copy or reinterpret any other visible feature. Do not treat hair or ears as armor. Do not copy pixelation, background, face, or rendering.. Image id: 4f71b705-03b4-4378-8f53-65b55946f8ff.

## Additional constraints and exclusions
This is only a shortening of the existing central upper point. Do not extend the helm. Do not add helmet coverage. Do not change the face framing. Do not create a circlet. Do not alter side pieces, brow pieces, cheek pieces, hair, ears, or face. Follow the crop only for the central point's proportional length. No text or watermark.

## Rendered-text policy
Do not render words, letters, numbers, captions, labels, signatures, watermarks, logos, or story copy. Keep all story text as editable Lorekeeper text outside the raster image.

## Output target and protected regions
Raster size: 1024x1024. Aspect ratio: 1:1.

## Edit discipline
Make the requested revision as one coherent image. Preserve the explicitly listed continuity priorities, but do not freeze every unmentioned pixel or secondary detail. Allow nearby pose, framing, lighting, background, texture, and geometry to adapt naturally when needed to integrate the edit. Keep unrelated major subjects and story facts recognizable without duplicating, deforming, or partially reconstructing them.

images.altText: Centered painted portrait of M'uru, a radiant faceless naaru formed from symmetrical violet crystalline structures suspended around a brilliant white-gold and rose-magenta core in a dark atmospheric chamber.
images.prompt:
## Intended use
Exploratory isolated canonical-appearance candidate for M'uru, establishing the naaru's stable physical design in the same project art style as the approved Falanaras portrait.

## Scene and background
M'uru hovers alone in a neutral frontal presentation, fully visible from the upper halo to the lowest suspended crystal forms. Faithfully translate the complete naaru design visible in the supplied in-game screenshot into finished fantasy illustration without redesigning its silhouette or structural arrangement.

## Subjects
M'uru only: a luminous naaru composed of suspended crystalline and metallic-looking arcane forms around an intense central core.

## Appearance and continuity anchors
Recreate M'uru's visible design from the screenshot with maximum fidelity: preserve the complete symmetrical silhouette, relative proportions, orientation, spacing, layering, and number of the suspended components; the upper halo and crown structure; paired luminous nodes; central vertical elements; broad outward and lower swept crystalline forms; pointed outer structures; long lower suspended pieces; violet-lavender surfaces; and brilliant white, pale gold, rose-magenta, and violet Light. The subject has no humanoid face, flesh, clothing, armor, limbs, or added decorative redesign.

## Action
Hovering motionlessly in a calm neutral state, components suspended in ordered symmetry around the radiant core; no attack or active binding.

## Expression, pose, and gaze
Non-humanoid and faceless; solemn, tranquil, sacred presence. Exactly frontal orientation for clear design readability.

## Setting and environment
A subdued, nearly abstract dark chamber with deep charcoal, muted wine, and faint smoky amber atmosphere. Only restrained hints of tall Thalassian arches may dissolve into shadow; the setting must remain secondary and must not copy the screenshot's game environment.

## Style, medium, and palette
Match the approved Falanaras portrait's polished hand-painted Warcraft fantasy illustration: layered digital paint, visible broken brush texture, varied line and edge quality, selective crispness on focal forms, softer atmospheric transitions, richly modeled but not glossy 3D-rendered surfaces. Preserve M'uru's own luminous white-gold, rose-magenta, and violet palette against a dark warm-neutral field; do not transfer Falanaras's black-crimson armor design or humanoid features.

## Camera and framing
Square full-design portrait, straight-on eye-level equivalent, centered and symmetrical, with comfortable margin around every outer point and the complete lower forms visible.

## Composition
M'uru occupies the central vertical axis and most of the frame; clear readable silhouette, balanced negative space around the outer crystalline points, subtle atmospheric depth behind the glow. No text landing zone is needed.

## Purposeful use of space
Unless the brief explicitly calls for a sparse, minimalist, isolated-study, or open-field composition, concentrate quiet negative space only in explicit text-reservation regions. Everywhere else, make each area contribute to subject, setting, atmosphere, depth, scale, motion, focus, or visual flow without adding clutter. Atmospheric open space is purposeful when it clearly establishes mood or scale; avoid large unmotivated blank areas and do not invent a text landing zone where none was requested.

## Lighting and mood
M'uru is the sole light source. Intense white-gold core, saturated rose-magenta radiance, violet translucency, soft colored bloom, and faint reflected light in the haze. Solemn, numinous, compassionate, and quietly sorrowful rather than aggressive.

## Reference image roles (actual provider input order)
Provider input image 1: authoritative canonical design reference for M'uru. Preserve: The exact visible naaru silhouette, component arrangement, symmetry, proportions, spacing, suspended structure, upper halo, central core, paired luminous nodes, crystalline forms, and white-gold, rose-magenta, violet luminosity.. Must change: Remove the in-game screenshot rendering, pixelation, interface text, red binding beams, prison apparatus, and background. Present M'uru alone in a calm neutral state.. Image id: 797612f9-cf31-443c-a2b8-51ef026edfd5.
Provider input image 2: approved project rendering-language reference only. Preserve: Polished hand-painted Warcraft fantasy finish, layered digital brushwork, visible color breakup, varied edges, selective crisp detail, dark atmospheric presentation, and rich but non-photoreal modeling.. Must change: Do not copy Falanaras, his anatomy, pose, armor, sword, heraldry, faceguard, palette distribution, or architecture. Replace the humanoid portrait with the screenshot-faithful non-humanoid M'uru design.. Image id: a22d39de-1219-4f9b-8475-2aab8132460d.

## Constraints and exclusions
Use the screenshot as the authoritative design reference and the approved Falanaras portrait only as the rendering-style reference. Preserve screenshot-faithful structure rather than inventing a generic angel, crystal golem, armored humanoid, or mechanical robot. No chains, red binding beams, prison pylons, captors, interface elements, labels, readable text, signature, or watermark. Keep the full silhouette uncropped and clearly separated from the background.

## Creative latitude
Meet every stated story, continuity, composition, and output requirement. Freely compose visual details that are not prescribed by the brief or references so the result feels intentional and coherent. Do not infer that unspecified details are forbidden, and do not add literal exclusions such as 'nothing else'.

## Rendered-text policy
Do not render words, letters, numbers, captions, labels, signatures, watermarks, logos, or story copy. Keep all story text as editable Lorekeeper text outside the raster image.

## Output target and protected regions
Raster size: 1024x1024. Aspect ratio: 1:1.
